Elegant Steak House
Sep 2026 • Business
Steak House The Fan's elegant and warm atmosphere brought me an unforgettable dining experience. From the moment of stepping through the restaurant's door, the elegant atmosphere and the waft of tempting roast beef instantly awakened all the taste buds. And the biggest highlight that evening was Mr. Hai's extremely enthusiastic and thoughtful service. He greeted us with a warm smile and proactively recommended the most suitable beef doneness according to our preferences. Mr. Hai's professional knowledge of the menu and his polite demeanor made every guest feel honored. Every steak presented was piping hot and juicy, and he also paid close attention to the details. It is precisely because of Mr. Hai's meticulousness and thoughtfulness that the delicious dishes appear richer and more unique. This is absolutely the ideal place I will go again without hesitation every time I want to eat steak.

Wonderful experience at Steak house - Furama resort
Sep 2026 • Friends
Honestly, this trip to Furama Resort left me with so many emotions, it was both fun and truly a perfect vacation. But what impressed and stayed with me the most was the dinner experience at the Steak House.
Sitting at the dining table looking out, the atmosphere here is truly amazing! The view embraces the lush green lawn connecting to the white sandy beach, with rows of coconut trees swaying in the evening sunset in the distance. The feeling of sitting under the cozy wooden roof, with the sea breeze blowing coolly, watching the sky change colors at dusk is truly chill and relaxing.
Besides the high-end space, the service quality here has nothing to complain about. The entire staff at the Steak House is very professional, gentle, and attentive to the smallest details.
Most notably, there is Mr. Hai. She served extremely delicately, like she was always observing and understanding the guests—before we even asked, she was already there, and whatever we needed was immediately available without disturbing our private space. Mr. Hai's dedication combined with this beautiful scenery makes the meal not just about enjoying the food, but also a very classy experience.
If I have the chance to return to Furama Resort, the Steak House and the warm welcome from everyone here will definitely be my top priority!
